answer: The cheapest real defence: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because crystal only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, quartz is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any sable approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
